text:
emma: rolled runtime-3.1.0 to canary (eu-north) at 2026-08-12T09:12Z. Deploybot auto-applied an auto-pin for model 'llama3q' after KV cache allocation jitter and small increase in tail latency. Do we hold and triage or immediately apply fallback routing?

deploybot: Deploy event: runtime-3.1.0 -> canary started 2026-08-12T09:12Z. Auto-pin: soft (cohort=canary, model=llama3q). Tags: kv-cache,longseq,latency. Link: https://deploy.redwood/6487654321 :robot_face:

rafael: Quick signal dump: kv_cache.alloc-fail spikes on 4 pods in eu-north; p50+p95 latencies +10ms/+65ms respectively for longseq requests. Affected volume ~0.7% of canary.

priya: paste logs sample: ```
[09:14:11] pod-a: kv_cache_alloc: retry(2) ok
[09:14:12] pod-b: kv_cache_alloc: OOM fallback -> slow kernel
[09:14:30] pod-d: trace: kv-cache miss -> cold load 42ms
```
lena: SDK note: sdk-ts 4.0.0 adds optional header X-RW-KV-PREFETCH which runtime-3.1 honors to pre-warm cache. Not required but can reduce cold misses.

ops-sre: Given <1% and nonfatal, recommend keep soft-pin for now plus two mitigations: 1) temp routing for seq>2048 -> runtime-2.30 2) set canary pod env KV_PREFETCH=true and lower max_batch_tokens to 384. Proposed routing JSON: ```json
{"route": [{"if":"seq>2048","to":"runtime-2.30"},{"else":"runtime-3.1.0"}], "canary_env": {"KV_PREFETCH":"true","MAX_BATCH_TOKENS":"384"}}
```
I can push route and env toggles now. Also propose auto-rollback rule: kv_cache_oom_rate > 1.2% over 5m OR p95 latency > 900ms -> rollback to runtime-2.30.

emma: +1 to that plan. Sam, can you add a line to the 3.1.0 release notes about kv-cache prefetch hint and the longseq caveat? And flag Dedicated/Private customers in eu-north for outreach.

sam: On it. Draft: "runtime-3.1.0 introduces kv-cache prefetch hint; known regression: rare kv-cache allocation jitter on longseq workloads in some environments. Mitigation: use X-RW-KV-PREFETCH or fallback routing to earlier runtime. Dedicated customers contacted." Sending email to ops-customer-success for eu-north lists.

rafael: Applying route & canary env now.

deploybot: Applied routing patch and env toggles at 09:19Z for cohort=canary. Logging changes to https://metrics.redwood/canary/6487654321.

ops-sre: Monitoring rules updated. Also created a short canary test job to hit longseq codepaths every 30s and report aggregate kv_cache_ooms. If oom_rate > 1.2% -> deploybot rollback hook will trigger.

priya: Quick A/B perf: enabled X-RW-KV-PREFETCH on a subset of canary pods; median longseq latency -8% and no new OOMs in 12m. Artifact: https://artifacts.redwood/6487654321/prefetch-test.

lena: I'll update SDK docs with an example: `client.setHeader('X-RW-KV-PREFETCH','1')` and a note for self-hosted setups to map the header in their ingress.

emma: Plan summary: 1) keep soft-pin 2) route seq>2048 to runtime-2.30 3) set KV_PREFETCH env on canary pods and ask customers to set header 4) lower max_batch_tokens to 384 5) auto-rollback triggers set 6) sam to update notes + outreach. Check back in 1h for stability signal.

rafael: Monitoring shows kv_cache_oom rate fell from 0.7% -> 0.15% after toggles. p95 latency improved slightly. Holding on watch.

ops-sre: Added final safety: if rollback executes, deploybot will also annotate the release notes with a rollback tag and post to #incidents automatically. Command wired: `deploybot rollback --target runtime-2.30 --scope cohort=canary --annotate rollback_kvcache`.

sam: Release notes updated and email sent to Dedicated contacts in eu-north. Also added a console banner: "If you use long sequence workloads, enable X-RW-KV-PREFETCH or pin to runtime-2.30 until stability confirmed."

priya: Running extended longseq probe now (30m run). Will post if any regressions.

emma: Closing for now. If alarms stay quiet for next hour we'll remove the soft-pin and proceed with regional rollout tomorrow. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
